== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1717. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1927|John Glasgow]] and [[Gemill-4|Mary Gemill]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1927]] is assessed at 76% (probable). Mary’s 1717 entry names John and Mary without maternal surname. Adjacent siblings support Gemmill household continuity strongly, but neither that sequence nor the 1704 marriage bridges the father to John-1927’s 1671 Linlithgow child.

Complete existing child-to-father-profile proposition, including the father’s childhood-to-adult identification; literal named parental role is stronger and assessed separately in the basis.

Next useful test: Reconcile 23 versus cited 25 July baptism and inspect maternal surname.
